# Systemia Yard Bounded Runtime Extension

Problem: An already-approved active Yard execution needs more runtime without receiving broader authority.
Pricing: Dynamic server quote only. Source defaults are not public price authority because deployment configuration can override them.
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: owned_runtime_migration_pending
Public capability: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/public/chum/capabilities/systemia-yard-runtime-extension-v1
Start here: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Human review fallback: null
Machine offer JSON: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Universal MCP: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp

Use when the user says or means:
- keep this approved agent run going longer
- buy more runtime for this Yard execution
- extend this bounded build run
- give this approved execution more time

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
